sections.label: s1
sections.text: A parcel leaves the warehouse at dawn.

sections.label: s2
sections.text: The parcel reaches the regional hub. The pickup locker is across the city, and a van drives the city route.

sections.label: s3
sections.text: A closed road forces a detour. The van arrives forty minutes late. The delay travels on to the customer.

sections.label: s4
sections.text: One closed road moved the whole promise.
